subject: Partner Synergy: Kickstart & Enablement Milestones
messages:
From: Laura Chen <l.chen@averysolutions.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Joint enablement pilot proposal / intro

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick connect last week — really excited about the potential fit between Avery Solutions and Redwood Inference for SI-led implementations. We've sketched a 6-week pilot to get two of our mutual customers live (overview attached). The high-level asks:

- 2-day trainer-ready enablement workshop for our consultants (remote)
- A partner playbook draft you can review and co-brand
- Access to a sandbox instance + short onboarding support (2 technical hours)

I've attached a one-page summary and a rough timeline. Can you share who from Redwood should own the enablement materials and the sandbox access? Also, do you have a standard partner discount structure for pilot engagements?

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Partnerships
Avery Solutions
Attachment: partner-playbook-draft.pdf (PDF, 320KB)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <l.chen@averysolutions.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint enablement pilot proposal / intro

Laura — thanks for the note and the crisp summary. This looks promising.

Quick answers up front:
- Owner(s): Naomi will lead enablement content; Priyom will coordinate the SI lab and technical materials. I'm tracking the commercial side.
- Sandbox & onboarding: we can provide a dedicated sandbox and two technical office hours; Priyom, can you confirm availability next week to run the lab?
- Partner pilot pricing: we typically offer a 15% pilot partner discount for first joint customers; I can escalate if you need a deeper pilot subsidy.

Next steps:
1) Naomi and Priyom to draft a 2-day agenda and a short pre-read by EOD Friday.
2) Laura to confirm pilot customer names and preferred dates (week of May 13 or May 20).
3) I'll create a HubSpot deal and share MLP (mutual action plan) doc for signatures.

Looping Naomi and Priyom in — thanks all.

—Rishi Malhotra
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0162
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, Laura Chen <l.chen@averysolutions.com>
Date: Thu, 2 May 2029 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft enablement agenda + integrator checklist

Hi team — attaching the integrator checklist and a first-pass 2-day agenda. Highlights:

Day 1 (Enablement fundamentals)
- 90m product recap and serving runtime primer
- 60m hands-on: sandbox provisioning & model variant mapping
- 60m troubleshooting and fallbacks (KV cache, batching lessons)

Day 2 (Delivery workshops)
- 120m architecture patterns for Dedicated & Private deployments
- 90m deployment lab: canary rollouts and tracing hooks
- 30m runbook & handoff to customer ops

Attachments: integrator-checklist.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

Notes: the checklist includes recommended assets (playbook, runbooks, pre-configured stack) and skill-level markers for consultants. Laura, if you can confirm the intended attendee profiles (cloud engineers vs solution consultants) I will tailor labs accordingly.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das | Technical Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <l.chen@averysolutions.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 May 2029 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft enablement agenda + integrator checklist

On Thu, 2 May 2029 at 08:02, priyom_das@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi team — attaching the integrator checklist and a first-pass 2-day agenda.
> 
> Notes: the checklist includes recommended assets (playbook, runbooks, pre-configured stack) and skill-level markers for consultants.

Thanks — this is exactly the level we need. Attendees will be 6 solution consultants and 2 cloud engineers for the pilot. The week of May 20 looks best for the enablement window.

Two asks from our side before we lock dates:
1) Can Redwood provide a short (15–30m) executive intro for customers on day 1? It helps cement the joint go-to-market message.
2) Pilot discount: 15% is a good start — would you confirm in writing and indicate whether that applies to both enablement hours and sandbox access?

I've put the partner playbook draft in a shared folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AveryPlaybookDraft — comments welcome.

Best,
Laura
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <l.chen@averysolutions.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 May 2029 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner Synergy: Kickstart & Enablement Milestones

Laura — great, thanks for confirming attendees and the target week. Quick confirmations and next steps:

- Executive intro: happy to do a 20-minute exec session on Day 1. I'll lead and Naomi will cover enablement goals.
- Pilot discount: confirmed 15% for the enablement scope and sandbox provisioning hours; does not apply to long-term Dedicated capacity purchases. We'll note that in the mutual action plan.
- HubSpot deal created: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567 (HUB-AV-2029-67890).
- I've attached a template mutual-action-plan.docx and requested an internal budget code for the pilot subsidy.

Action items for this thread:
1) Laura to share final attendee list + two customer names by Friday May 3.
2) Priyom to finalize lab exercises and upload runbooks to the shared folder.
3) Marissa (cc'd) will connect Avery to our partner enablement portal and share co-brandable slide deck assets.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite for May 21–22 (proposed). Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
